In Q2, the maxname CTE uses MAX(drinker) after joining with maxfreq. Since MAX is applied across all rows, if there are ties in times_a_week, it would pick the lexicographically largest drinker. So the tiebreaker is different here.

So if there are two drinkers with same times_a_week, Q1 picks the smaller name, Q2 picks the larger name. That's a key difference.

So, if there's a scenario where two drinkers have the same max times_a_week, the subquery in Q1 would return the one with the smaller name, while Q2 would return the one with the larger name. That would make the two queries produce different results in such a case.
